description: Daily Zensei Index scores for the last `days` calendar days, with the regime of each day. Free access covers the last 31 days; Premium covers up to 3650 days. The Zensei Index is a RISK score from 0 to 100: LOWER IS HEALTHIER. 0-20 Supportive, 20-40 Vulnerable, 40-70 Stressed, 70-100 Restrictive. A rising score means conditions are deteriorating, not improving.

days.description: Calendar days to look back. Default 30, max 3650.
days.title: between(1, 3650)
